code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    seen=set()
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]==8 or (r,c) in seen: continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<H and 0<=xx<W and g[yy][xx]!=8 and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
            r0=min(y for y,x in cells); r1=max(y for y,x in cells)+1
            c0=min(x for y,x in cells); c1=max(x for y,x in cells)+1
            colored=[(y,x) for y,x in cells if g[y][x] not in (0,8)]
            if not colored: continue
            a=min(y for y,x in colored); b=max(y for y,x in colored)+1
            d=min(x for y,x in colored); e=max(x for y,x in colored)+1
            ph,pw=b-a,e-d
            tile=[[g[a+i][d+j] for j in range(pw)] for i in range(ph)]
            # seed location indicates the corner of its repeating tile
            for y in range(r0,r1):
                for x in range(c0,c1):
                    iy=(y-a)%ph; ix=(x-d)%pw
                    g[y][x]=tile[iy][ix]
    return g
'''
